answer: 68% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. Because the zephyr burn is published at the karst settlement, the copper audit exposes the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. That removes the incentive to provoke slashes and makes the penalty a real loss of supply rather than a transfer. A 314 account operation therefore ties up 15 million dollars of idle capital.
